newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - July 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - July 17.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Dubai Cargo Village is expected to handle over one million tonnes of cargo by 2010, village director Ali al-Jallaf said.
- The Ajman-based Transtrade Overseas Ltd will run Dubai-based Western Oil Company's waste oil recycling plant on a management contract for a trial basis.
- More than seven billion dirhams have been spent on marine drilling and reclamation projects by the Abu Dhabi Public Works Department since 1979.
- Emirates Equity Fund has revised the subscription limit for foreign nationals upwards to 49 percent from a previous 20 percent.
- A liquefied petroleum gas plant is being established in Oman's central province with production capacity of 40,000 tonnes a year.
